title: AI Pixar Style Generator
summary: Make Pixar style AI images: soft rounded 3D characters, big expressive eyes, warm light and posters for your own films. Describe it and generate. Free to try.
body_markdown:
### What is the Pixar animation style?


The Pixar animation style is the look of modern 3D animated feature films: soft rounded characters with big heads and large expressive eyes, detailed materials such as fur and fabric, skin that glows slightly in the light, and warm, softly bounced lighting.


### How do I make Pixar style AI art?


Describe an original character with an age, a body shape, one prop and one feeling, ask for a 3D animated feature film still with rounded proportions and big expressive eyes, and add soft global illumination and a warm light source.


### How do I turn a photo of myself into a Pixar character?


Add the photo as a reference image and describe yourself as a 3D animated film character, naming the features to keep, such as hair, glasses and clothes; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images.


### Can I make an AI Pixar style poster?


Yes. Describe the characters and one striking image above them, then put the title in quotes and ask for it spelled exactly as written; invent your own film rather than copying a real poster, since studio titles and logos are trademarks.


### Can I turn a Pixar style image into a video?


Yes. Generate the still first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one gentle action and a feeling, such as a girl's gasp turning into a smile, and ask it to keep the 3D animated look.


### Is the Pixar AI generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 costs 5 credits an image. To animate a still, choose Auto in the image to video node and Flick picks the video model.
